title: ぼくの手はきみのために [BOKU NO TE WA KIMI NO TAME NI]
author: Takuji Ichikawa
thought: The third story in the book is spectacularly beautiful. It's almost the perfect story of how humanity can be when everyone does care for others. Almost because I'm still pity for the Hatsune's daughter. I'm grateful that this is not a full novel because it might be having more fillers and losing the momentum of the story. It took me 6 days to go through the first two stories (not bad but not amazingly good either), however, the last one had me sitting through in one evening till late night.
